NewRocket is a company filled with world class talent, guided by empathetic leadership, and teams of collaborators and innovators who spark inspiration! Come join our Crew!

Careers at newrocket

People Matter. Employees Matter. You Matter.

At NewRocket, people are not just the backbone; they're the heartbeat. We champion diversity, celebrate creativity, and embrace the uniqueness each person brings to the table. Here, it's not just about a job; it's about fostering a healthy work-life balance, creating a culture that thrives on collaboration and innovation, and supporting professional growth for individuals and teams.

We believe in creating meaningful experiences, not just for our clients but for every member of our crew. Your voice matters, your growth matters, and you matter. Join us for a journey where your uniqueness is not only recognized but celebrated, and together, let's create something extraordinary.

LEARNING AND GROWTH

Encouraging employee growth with NewRocket University

NewRocket was one of a handful of strategic partners to sign a ServiceNow Enterprise Training agreement, allowing our employees unrestricted access to ServiceNow learning content and certification to continuously up-skill and accelerate their career growth. We wholeheartedly invest in your professional development through a company-funded learning program, empowering you to steer your career journey. Imagine the excitement of gaining new skills, exploring diverse opportunities, and advancing your career, all with the full support of an organization committed to your growth and success.
